w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lizelle just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Sam. Buffering, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Sam lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: Travel 1 tile to grove.
It followed you. The Herald is here.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Sanne freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Leo: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Editor, The Timeslot, Big Loud) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
firstContext: 🌿 Feng returns from foraging the wilds: +143 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 143 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
📣 Aurora found a cache out there — enough to matter.
🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Editor, The Timeslot, Big Loud) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Editor came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.

🚨 The Editor, The Timeslot, Big Loud is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It sits. Just... sits. Watching. The others are out there too, you can feel them.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Lizelle opens the pantry wide: 2× Expedition haul, 2× Foraged food, 2× Blackberry. Feng, Sanne eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−1,530 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

⛔ THE COMMERCIAL BREAK does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. The march needs 20 allied blades (you have 0). Sound the call. This is not courage. This is arithmetic.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/12/7), with 5 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 38 → 24 · capped · Craft 12 · Talk 13 · Explore 50 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Zoe Adams ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Diana Osei and Zoe Adams ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
